prompt: In the paper "Aluminium Metal Matrix Composites – A Review," which alloy of aluminium was evaluated for physical properties by Mahendra Boopathi M. et al.?
answer: Mahendra Boopathi M. et al. evaluated **Aluminium 2024 (Al-2024)** for its physical properties.
